title: SR-5.04 Paid tiers sell only what is built, on every surface
request: Closes G45: The $12 tier advertises automatic merge, which does not exist; the pricing test covers docs but not the site. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none.

tasks.title: Pricing truth from one table
requirements: a machine-readable status table (built, planned, date) is the single source; docs and the site render from it
a feature listed in a paid tier must be built or carry a delivery date

the status table carries a tiers section: each tier's name, its monthly and yearly prices in each currency the docs show, and its computer and member limits, equal to the pricing table in docs/PRICING.md, so the site renders every tier fact from the copy QL-1.06's gate sync brings in; the trial's size is a separate entry, never a tier limit

every service the tiers docs sell (setup, support, the rate-card services in docs/tiers/services.md) is a status-table row marked staffed or not staffed; a service that is not staffed is shown as planned in docs and in the exported site data, never as sold

the status table carries one positioning entry, the tagline, first the README's line (Shared context and coordination for the AI tools you already use) until the owner chooses another; the README's bold tagline equals it
docs/PRICING.md's table gives each price in USD and in CHF, as README.md and docs/SOLUTIONS.md already state them, and test/pricing-docs.test.mjs accepts both forms

the status table has one row for each AI app memev connects (each client id that src/cli/clients.mjs defines) marked built, and a planned row for each app or provider that the docs or the site name as coming
the claim-phrase checks take each block element of a page, and each blank-line block of a Markdown file, as a unit of its own, so a sibling tag never lends its 'planned' to the next paragraph
each planned row's claim phrases include at least the floor the test holds for that part, every phrase matches some sentence of the surfaces, and matching ignores case and collapses whitespace
the service rows of docs/status.json are exactly the services sold in docs/tiers/services.md, docs/PRICING.md, docs/tiers/README.md and the support sections of the site

scripts/status-table.mjs renders the tier facts (each price in USD and CHF, the member, computer and connector limits, and the positioning line) into marked regions of site/web/personal.html, solutions.html and index.html
this task moves no part from planned to built and drops no planned row

wherever a paid tier names a planned part, in docs, on the site or in the CLI's plan text, the sentence carries the part's delivery date from docs/status.json, a real date no earlier than the contract's base
the built app rows are exactly the apps clientDefs connects, read at test time, and an id that unsupportedDefs lists is never built
no module under src/ imports from scripts/, so the published package loads without it
the h1 of site/web/index.html equals the positioning entry

criteria.statement: This scan is written by the spec owner, not the implementer, and fails at base. In site/web/*.html, each block element (p, li, h1-h6, td, th, tr, dt, dd, div, ul, ol, main, section, header, footer, nav) is its own block, so a sibling tag never joins the next paragraph; all other tags are stripped and entities decoded. In README.md and docs/**/*.md, blank lines split blocks. Within a block, sentences split after . ! or ?. Every sentence matching /nothing to resolve|automatic merge|merges changes made in several places|full merge engine|edit on two machines at once/i must also match /\bplanned\b/i, and the command prints each offender. Measured on the base worktree (a read-only run): exit 1, with 13 offenders. They include site/web/personal.html:56, site/web/video.html:38 and :46, README.md:155 and :184, docs/tiers/free.md:48-50 and :74, docs/tiers/README.md:22, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:85-88, docs/LICENSING-NOTICE.md:20-21, two in docs/CONVERGENCE.md and one in docs/PAID-CONVERGENCE.md. The PRICING.md:29 row label is not flagged, because its row carries 'planned'.

criteria.statement: The test holds a literal map from each planned part, named as in base docs/tiers/README.md:73-94, to its minimum phrases. Company vault: 'syncs into one company vault' and 'company admin console'. Sign-in row: 'SCIM'. SIEM row: 'SIEM' and 'legal hold'. HA row: 'high availability'. Sync: 'end-to-end encrypted sync'. Relay: 'stable address'. Merge: the four spec phrases plus 'merging of concurrent edits' and 'merges edits'. The test asserts that each status.json planned row's phrases include that floor, and that each phrase matches at least one sentence in the surfaces, so none is dead. Matching is case-insensitive over whitespace-collapsed text.
